_comment: The `fine` dimension of the DRY gate (scripts/check-dry.mjs).
minTokens was 15 and it flagged 2,316 clones, only 39% of which were 8 lines
or longer. Over the two PRs after the gate landed it flagged 9 new clones; 2
were real and 7 were baselined. A gate you override every few PRs stops being
read, and I was the one overriding it.
At 40 the flag volume is 6x lower and 78% of what remains is 8+ lines:
What this does NOT do is separate convention from logic. Verified by planting
the exact idiom that got baselined in #2226 - `const tdb = args.tdb ??
createTenantDb(...)` beside a clock read - as a function body in two modules:
it is STILL flagged at 40 tokens. jscpd measures size, not meaning, so no
threshold makes it smart. This change buys a lower override rate, not a
signal that is right more often.
A bet with a review date: if the next few PRs again come back mostly-baselined,
retire this dimension rather than lower the threshold a third time. A gate
nobody trusts catches nothing, and the coarse dimension still covers large
